definitions: To row; propel a boat through water with oars.
To flail or thrash with one's arms or legs.
Usage note: In political commentary and everyday discussion, the separable verb "zurückrudern" is standard for backtracking or retracting a controversial statement.
examples: Früh am Morgen ruderten die beiden Athleten über den spiegelglatten See.
Early in the morning, the two athletes rowed across the mirror-smooth lake.
Vor Schreck verlor er das Gleichgewicht und ruderte wild mit den Armen.
Startled, he lost his balance and flailed wildly with his arms.
Nach der heftigen Kritik an der geplanten Steuerreform musste die Ministerin öffentlich zurückrudern.
Following fierce criticism of the planned tax reform, the minister had to publicly backtrack.

definitions: To scratch or scrape; to rub the skin to relieve itching, or rub a hard surface to remove a coating.

Usage note: Used intransitively with an inanimate subject, the verb means to feel scratchy or cause itching, especially of rough clothing or fabric.
examples: Chaque matin d'hiver, il doit gratter le pare-brise gelé avant de pouvoir prendre la route.
Every winter morning, he has to scrape the frozen windshield before he can hit the road.
Le cycliste a réussi à gratter trois secondes dans le dernier virage pour remporter l'étape.
The cyclist managed to shave off three seconds on the final turn to win the stage.
Ce pull en laine brute gratte tellement qu'il est impossible de le porter à même la peau.
This raw wool sweater is so scratchy that it is impossible to wear it directly against the skin.

definitions: Just or simply; indicates acceptance of an unavoidable fact or self-evident circumstance (umgangssprachlich).
Usage note: Shares the meaning of "eben" in conversational speech, but belongs to spoken discourse and is avoided in formal writing.
examples: Da kann man jetzt halt nichts mehr machen.
There is simply nothing more that can be done about it now.
Wenn die Bahn streikt, muss ich halt von zu Hause aus arbeiten.
If the trains are on strike, I will just have to work from home.
